title: Weather widget temperature overlay obscures a lot of the current weather icon, especially at small icon size/panel thickness
line: With “Show temperature: Over the widget icon”, the temperature badge now sits in the weather icon's corner instead of hiding its whole lower half.
explanation: In “Over the widget icon” mode the weather applet puts a BadgeOverlay (a Kirigami.Badge) on the icon's bottom-right corner. With the unit the text (“47°F”) plus the extra horizontal padding Kirigami.Badge gives pill-shaped badges made the badge wider than a typical panel icon (31 px on a 22 px icon at a 46 px panel), so it was centered and hid the whole lower half of the icon. The badge now shows only the degrees (“47°”, the unit stays in the tooltip and in “Beside” mode), and BadgeOverlay drops Kirigami's extra pill padding, so the badge is 19 px wide and sits in the icon's corner like other badges, with the icon at its normal size.

commits.message:
applets/weather: drop the unit from the temperature badge

The badge with the unit ("47°F") was wider than a typical panel icon, so
it was centered over the icon and hid its whole lower half. Showing only
the degrees keeps it in the icon's corner; the tooltip keeps the unit.

BUG: 497471

BadgeOverlay: don't add extra horizontal padding

Kirigami.Badge gives pill-shaped badges extra padding on both sides that
BadgeOverlay's zero padding doesn't remove, so badges over icons were
wider than their text needs and covered more of the icon than necessary.

BUG: 497471

patches.diff:
From 606d214c7a377a18da8806f628a6153f12192b24 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 01:30:36 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/weather: drop the unit from the temperature badge
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The badge with the unit ("47°F") was wider than a typical panel icon, so
it was centered over the icon and hid its whole lower half. Showing only
the degrees keeps it in the icon's corner; the tooltip keeps the unit.

BUG: 497471
---
 applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
index c66ae91a7..12dbc9a9c 100644
--- a/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -72,7 +72,7 @@ Loader {
 
                 visible: compactRoot.isTemperaturePresent && compactRoot.showTemperature && compactRoot.useBadge && text.length > 0
 
-                text: compactRoot.isTemperaturePresent ? Util.temperatureToDisplayString(compactRoot.displayTemperatureUnit, compactRoot.lastObservation.temperature, compactRoot.metaData.temperatureUnit, true, false) : "";
+                text: compactRoot.isTemperaturePresent ? Util.temperatureToDisplayString(compactRoot.displayTemperatureUnit, compactRoot.lastObservation.temperature, compactRoot.metaData.temperatureUnit, true, true) : "";
                 icon: parent
 
                 // Non-default state to center if the badge is wider than the icon
-- 
2.53.0

From ac830070a2f0a978485a442043b51bfd285fbdbc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 01:30:36 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] BadgeOverlay: don't add extra horizontal padding

Kirigami.Badge gives pill-shaped badges extra padding on both sides that
BadgeOverlay's zero padding doesn't remove, so badges over icons were
wider than their text needs and covered more of the icon than necessary.

BUG: 497471
---
 components/workspace/BadgeOverlay.qml | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/components/workspace/BadgeOverlay.qml b/components/workspace/BadgeOverlay.qml
index 6660928651..7151d98a2c 100644
--- a/components/workspace/BadgeOverlay.qml
+++ b/components/workspace/BadgeOverlay.qml
@@ -16,6 +16,8 @@ Kirigami.Badge {
 
     customColor: Qt.alpha(Kirigami.Theme.backgroundColor, 0.9)
     padding: 0
+    // Kirigami.Badge adds extra horizontal padding to pill-shaped badges, which makes them cover much more of the icon
+    horizontalPadding: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing / 2
     font.bold: false
     font.pointSize: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont.pointSize - 1
 }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: 46 px panel, master: the 47°F badge is wider than the icon and hides its whole lower half
46 px panel with the fix: same icon size, the 47° badge sits in the corner and the cloud and moon stay visible
64 px panel, master: 46°F badge over the bottom of the icon
64 px panel with the fix: a smaller 47° badge in the icon's corner
System tray on master: weather (46°F) and battery (99%) badges
System tray with the fix: the weather badge shows 47° and both badges are narrower

review.text: Both changes are minimal, clean, and target the right repos: dropping the unit letter from the weather compact badge via the existing degreesOnly option (keeping it in tooltips and Beside mode) and overriding Kirigami.Badge's excess pill horizontalPadding in BadgeOverlay. Together they shrink the badge from 31 px to 19 px so it stays corner-anchored on default 46 px and larger panels while also tightening other icon badges like battery percentage. Tiny panels (<=36 px) remain inherently constrained by the 16 px icon size without a VDG layout redesign, and using CCBUG on the plasma-workspace commit would be a minor polish, but the fix is maintainer-ready.
